title: Chuyên đề thực tế - Thống kê kinh tế
duration: 15 hours of theory, 45 hours of practice

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Apply statistical methods to analyze real-world data and solve practical problems.
Conduct research and gather data to understand and evaluate statistical activities in various organizations.
Identify and address issues in statistical practices within organizations.
Produce comprehensive reports detailing statistical applications and recommendations for improvement.
Collaborate effectively in groups to complete projects and tasks.
Manage time efficiently to meet project deadlines and requirements.
Effectively communicate findings and recommendations to stakeholders.
Collect and analyze data from various sources to support statistical analysis.
Use statistical software to process and analyze data.
Apply statistical techniques to economic data and scenarios.
Utilize statistical methods in business contexts to inform decision-making.
Conduct market research using statistical tools and techniques.
Analyze and evaluate statistical information critically to make informed decisions.
